# Copper Scroll Column 8 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Copper Scroll Column 8 (treasure locations 31-36) where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 8:1 — at the middle of / between / midway between + stones/boulders

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "at the middle of the two stones" |
| LOGOS | "between the two stones" |
| PNEUMA | "midway between two boulders" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's literal "at the middle of the two stones." LOGOS and PNEUMA interpret the spatial relationship; PNEUMA's "boulders" is unwarranted.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 8:2 — head/top + ravine/gorge

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "at the head of the ravine" |
| LOGOS | "at the top of the ravine" |
| PNEUMA | "at the head of the gorge" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "at the head of the ravine" — "head" is literal for rosh, "ravine" is standard for nachal in this context.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 8:4 — pitchers/jars + offering/sacred offerings

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "ten pitchers of offering" |
| LOGOS | "ten pitchers of offering" |
| PNEUMA | "ten jars of sacred offerings" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "ten pitchers of offering" per EMET/LOGOS. "Pitchers" for kaddim; PNEUMA's "sacred" is added.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 8:5 — Under/Beneath + monument of Absalom / Absalom's monument

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Under the monument of Absalom" — literal yad Avshalom |
| LOGOS | "Beneath the monument of Absalom" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "Beneath Absalom's monument" — possessive |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "Beneath the monument of Absalom" — "beneath" is slightly more precise for buried treasure; construct-chain word order preserved.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 8:15 — upper part/portion/section

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "in the upper part" |
| LOGOS | "in the upper portion" |
| PNEUMA | "in the upper section" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "in the upper part" per EMET as the simplest and most natural.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

*Total disagreements in Column 8: 5*
